blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 China swept host Japan 25-19, 25-20, 25-23 on Tuesday to capture its third straight Asian Games women’s volleyball gold medal and a record-extending 10th title in the competition. China controlled the first two sets before Japan mounted its strongest challenge in the third, only for the defending champions to close out the match 25-23. The victory completed a demanding two-day finish for China, which had needed five sets to eliminate Thailand in Monday’s semifinals.
